reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Matte sun stick : Mugwort + Camelia 18g
reviews.text: This works great for oily skin! I have a more oily T zone but 1 swipe and it’s matte. The feeling of the product is soft too after you apply it. Plus there’s like no streak or white cast. It will move your makeup a bit but I think there no sunscreen stick that won’t. You’re literally swiping your skin so it makes sense. I wish there’s was more product bc it’s so good!
reviews.zh: 呢枝防曬棒好啱油性肌膚用！我自己係T字位比較油，但係一抹就即刻變霧面。搽完之後質感都好柔軟。而且基本上冇色痕同泛白嘅問題。佢會稍微推動到你嘅妝容，但係我覺得冇防曬棒可以完全唔推妝。你本身就係喺塊面度嚟嚟掃掃，會推妝都好合理。我希望枝棒嘅容量可以再多啲，因為真係好好用！

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Matte sun stick : Mugwort + Camelia 18g
reviews.text:
Based from the picture honestly though there would be two with the purchase, but don’t be fooled like me it only comes with one. 

Nevertheless I am loving this product, its application is so effortlessly and it leaves your skin with a matte finish. Which for someone that suffers with oily skin this is a plus since it helps me throughout my day to not only protect against the sun but also so my skin won’t look oily. 

Definitely buy this product.
reviews.zh:
講真，睇圖片會以為買一送二，但唔好畀佢呃到，我買嘅時候淨係得一枝。

不過我真係好鍾意呢件產品，搽上去好順手，搽完之後皮膚會變成霧面妝效。對我呢種油性肌嚟講真係加分，因為佢可以幫我成日對抗油光之餘，又可以防曬。

強烈推薦入手。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Matte sun stick : Mugwort + Camelia 18g
reviews.text: I just wanted to say, definitely buy this product from olive young or somewhere from korean store. I swear to god. I bought a version from Amazon thinking it was legit only to find out it was a dud. The texture from the amazon one was terrible. Melted simply being out and about and i hated the texture only to discover it wasn't thr real product. Now i officially have the real one. I could see a dratic change between the two. The difference between the package all the way to the texture of the product. A warning to others dont buy it from Amazon. But this product from Olive Young. Im so excited to try this product again and give it a secone chance.
reviews.zh: 我淨係想講，一定要去 Olive Young 或者韓國嘅店舖買呢件產品。我發誓。我喺 Amazon 買咗一支以為係正品，點知係假貨。嗰支嘅質地差到不得了，淨係帶出街一陣就溶晒，我好憎嗰個質感，後嚟先發現原來唔係正品。而家我終於買到真貨，我可以見到兩者之間有好大嘅差別，由包裝到產品嘅質感都唔同。提提大家唔好喺 Amazon 買，記得去 Olive Young 買。我好興奮可以再用多次呢件產品，畀佢第二次機會。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Matte sun stick : Mugwort + Camelia 18g
reviews.text: Overall, not a bad sun screen stick. The only thing that I'd comment on is that this particular sun stick is a little bit heavier than other sun sticks I've tried (my preference is Round Lab, but this one is still good too!). It tends to go on with a slightly thicker feature and has more of a tacky/sticky feeling to it. The feel eventually goes away, but just the initial application has made this particular stick my back up.
reviews.zh: 整體嚟講，呢枝防曬棒唔算差。我唯一想講嘅係，呢枝比起我試過嘅其他防曬棒會重身少少（我自己最鍾意 Round Lab，但呢枝都仲係唔錯！）。佢搽上去會比較厚身，仲會有少少黐立立嘅感覺。感覺過一陣就會散，但係單係剛搽上去嗰陣嘅感覺，已經令呢枝變咗我做後備之選。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Matte sun stick : Mugwort + Camelia 18g
reviews.text: Unfortunately, this did not live up to the hype for me. It works very well as a final matte layer after I apply my sunscreen in the morning, but every time I've used this as a reapplication during a hike, it pills horribly and makes my skin start flaking. It does glide on smoothly on clean skin and I love the matte effect but it doesn't seem to work for me after I've been sweating or out in the sun.
reviews.zh: 可惜嘅係，呢枝對我嚟講冇外間講到咁好用。早上搽完防曬之後，用佢做最後一層霧面定妝效果係好好嘅，但係每次行山補搽嘅時候，佢就會起晒毛粒，仲搞到我塊面開始甩皮。佢喺乾淨嘅皮膚上面滑得好順，霧面效果我都好鍾意，但係一到我出汗或者喺太陽底下之後再用就完全唔掂。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Matte sun stick : Mugwort + Camelia 18g
reviews.text: I have pretty oily skin and decided to get this sun stick since it's matte, I noticed a significant difference once applied and absolutely love how it left my skin looking. The only thing I have to say is that even once I left my house to run errands I could still feel it on my face, almost like a waxy type feeling? It didn't really bother me and I just massaged it into my skin so it personally wasn't a big issue but for others it might be. It left my skin feeling really soft and didn't leave a white cast which was something I was mainly looking for in sunscreens.
reviews.zh: 我自己皮膚好油，因為佢係霧面嘅所以決定買嚟試下，一搽完即時見到明顯分別，我好鍾意佢令到我塊面望落去嘅效果。唯一想講嘅係，就算我出咗門口去辦事，塊面上面仲係 feel 到佢嘅存在，差唔多係有種蠟嘅感覺？對我嚟講唔算太大問題，我自己會按摩推開，但係其他人可能會介意。搽完之後皮膚摸落好柔軟，而且都冇泛白，呢樣係我揀防曬最主要嘅要求。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Matte sun stick : Mugwort + Camelia 18g
reviews.text: Really nice stick! It is definitely a matte stick, but not so matte that it makes your face look flat. The smell is nice and goes on evenly. I did try to put it over makeup and mine did shift a bit, but I also am not using high end makeup. I also might've pressed too hard. Others have been able to wear it over makeup and not have to smear. I will defiently use over the summer!
reviews.zh: 真係一支唔錯嘅防曬棒！佢確實係霧面棒，但唔會霧到令你塊面睇起嚟好平板。味道唔錯，搽得好均勻。我試過搽喺妝上面，的確有少少推動到我嘅妝，但係我都唔係用緊貴價嘅化妝品。而且我可能撳得太大力。其他人用佢嚟補妝都唔會有呢個問題。夏天一定會繼續用！

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Matte sun stick : Mugwort + Camelia 18g
reviews.text: I have dry skin so I didn’t like it at first bc it made my skin a bit dry, however this is a great sunscreen for reapplication after using an oily products. My first sunscreen of the day is oily so this sunscreen stick helps throughout the day when I reapply. If you have dry skin don’t use as an initial sunscreen and stick to reapplication!
reviews.zh: 我係乾性肌，一開始唔鍾意呢枝，因為佢會令我皮膚更乾。但係如果用完一款比較油嘅防曬之後用佢嚟補搽，佢就好正。我早上第一支防曬係偏油嘅，所以之後用呢枝防曬棒補搽就啱晒成日用。如果你係乾性肌，就唔好當佢第一支防曬嚟用，留嚟補搽就啱。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
